description: Steady-state understeer bicycle (psi_dot = v*delta_eff / (L + K_us*v^2)) with per-platform steering scale/bias and a first-order lag tau. Coefficients fit per-platform via Nelder-Mead on all available Ford segments.
tesla_handling: Tesla data has no yaw_rate_meas_rads truth; predict() returns yaw rate using Mach-E coefficients with Tesla wheelbase as a benign default.
